name: Toolbar
summary: A grouped row of interactive controls — buttons, toggle buttons, dropdowns, dividers — sharing a single tab stop. Used as page-level command bars (above a Table), as floating contextual editor toolbars (rich text), and as dialog footers (the primary/secondary pair). Roving tabindex inside; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight cycles within the group.

ariaLabel.description: Required label for SR users — 'Page actions', 'Text formatting', 'Filter and sort'.

density.description: compact: 28 px, sm buttons. regular: 36 px, md buttons (touch floor on mobile).

elevation.description: border: hairline edge (sticky page toolbar). card: floating elevated toolbar (rich text editor).

wrap.description: When true and the toolbar exceeds width, items wrap to the next row. When false, items overflow into a 'More' DropdownMenu.

keyboard: Tab - enter the toolbar (focus lands on the first item)
Tab - leave the toolbar (move focus past)
rules: Roving tabindex — only one item is in the tab order at a time.
Vertical dividers between groups carry role='separator' and aria-orientation='vertical'.
Overflow 'More' menu: aria-label='More actions', uses the same DropdownMenu primitive.

do: Group related controls with vertical dividers.
Lead with the most common action; tail with destructive (and color-code it as danger-soft, not solid danger, in toolbars).
Use IconButton + Tooltip for icon-only items.
Wrap on narrow widths; collapse to 'More' on dense operator surfaces.
When the toolbar floats (rich text editor) use elevation='card' with shadow.popover and a small inset border.
dont: Don't put a Select that's the primary form field inside a Toolbar — that goes in the Form.
Don't render a Toolbar without aria-label.
Don't stack two Toolbars vertically on the same surface — combine.
Don't paint the toolbar surface in lime — chrome, not action.

changelog.note: Initial Toolbar contract. Roving tabindex. Group dividers. Wrap-or-overflow modes.
